skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand terms related to web applications, web programming languages, database management systems, hyper-text markup language, cascading style sheets, etc.
Explain and apply front-end and back-end programming concepts in practical scenarios.
Deploy, operate, and develop web applications for businesses.
Proficiently use HTML, CSS, JavaScript, MySQL, and PHP to develop web-based applications.
Develop systematic thinking and modeling skills for web development.
Demonstrate ability to self-study and continuously update knowledge on web development.
Work independently or actively participate in group activities.
Demonstrate social responsibility and professional ethics in the field of information systems management.

minimum_entry_skills.skill_name: Basic knowledge of networking and communication
